title: 第2章 氪金就变强
novel_title: 绑定全国，每人每天给我一两银
content_zh:
重活一世，陆舟眼下唯一的依靠就只有手中的发钱系统。

    他仔细查看系统的介绍……

    这系统除了每日可获得白银之外，还能够借助白银提升武道境界，并推演、补全各类功法武技。

    氪金就变强！

    陆舟眼前一亮。

    这简直就是救命稻草！

    要知道，前身虽是大周太子，却是个实打实的武道废材，借着嫡长子的身份占着储君之位，德不配位，才招来今日祸端。

    如今，有了这个系统，他便可以直接提升武道境界，毫无门槛。

    如此一来，自己将不再是待宰羔羊，即便面对危险，也有一战之力。

    想到这里，陆舟内心就不免生出几分激动。

    他清楚记得，这方世界，强大武者是能够飞天遁地，焚山煮海的。

    前世他庸碌一生，如今自然想见识见识强者风光。

    只是，自己此刻手中的白银，究竟能提升到何种境界？

    依照记忆，陆舟清晰知晓，这个世界的武者共分为一到九品，九品最次，一品最强。

    每一层境界的差距，宛若天堑。

    除此之外，若能突破一品武者的桎梏，便能跻身三大神境。

    神境之威，难以想象……

    而前身作为大周太子，如今不过是九品中级武者而已，实在寒酸。

    陆舟收回心思，强压翻腾的思绪，看向那87万4千6百22两白银，没有丝毫犹豫，一股脑全都用在了境界提升上。

    眼下，自身实力才是王道！

    唯有足够强，才能活下去！

    轰！

    一声轰鸣，陡然响起。

    系统的提示音，接连浮现……

    【消耗2万两白银，境界提升至九品高级！】

    【消耗5万两白银，境界提升至九品顶级！】

    【消耗10万两白银，境界提升至八品初级！】

    ……

    白银数量在飞速消耗，陆舟的境界也在一路飙升。

    他只觉得体内气血在不停奔腾，犹如决堤洪流，不断冲刷着体内的主经脉。

    每一次冲刷，都带来一种难以形容的舒适感，宛若任督二脉被瞬间打通般，毫无滞涩。

    浑厚的力量，自体内滋生……

    爽！

    陆舟看着自己踏入八品武者范畴，喜悦之色已溢于言表。

    要知道，前身努力了二十多年，不过堪堪九品初级。

    无数武道天骄，日夜苦修，也需耗费数年心血才能迈入八品。

    而他，仅凭一笔白银，便站到了不少人梦寐以求的高度！

    这种感觉简直不要太爽！

    而且……

    这还远远没有结束。

    成为八品武者，才消耗了不到一半的白银。

    剩下的白银还在消耗，而他的境界也在继续提升……

    【消耗36万两白银，境界提升至八品顶级！】
content_en:
After reviving his life, Lu Zhou's only reliance now is the money distribution system in his hand.

    He carefully checked the system introduction...

    In addition to earning silver every day, this system can also use silver to improve the martial arts realm and deduce and complete various martial arts skills.

    Krypton gold will make you stronger!

    Lu Zhou's eyes lit up.

    This is simply a life-saver!

    You must know that although his predecessor was the prince of Zhou Dynasty, he was actually a martial arts waste. He occupied the position of crown prince by virtue of his identity as the eldest son. His virtue was not worthy of the position, which led to today's disaster.

    Now, with this system, he can directly improve his martial arts realm without any threshold.

    In this way, he will no longer be a lamb to be slaughtered, and he will still be able to fight even in the face of danger.

    Thinking of this, Lu Zhou couldn't help but feel a little excited in his heart.

    He clearly remembered that in this world, powerful warriors could fly to the sky and escape from the earth, burning mountains and boiling seas.

    In his previous life, he lived a mediocre life, but now he naturally wants to see the splendor of the strong.

    But, to what level can the silver in my hand be improved to?

    According to his memory, Lu Zhou clearly knew that the warriors in this world were divided into grades one to nine, with grade nine being the least powerful and grade one being the strongest.

    The gap between each level is like a chasm.

    In addition, if you can break through the shackles of a first-level warrior, you can become one of the three great gods.

    The power of the divine realm is unimaginable...

    As the former Prince of Zhou Dynasty, he is now only a ninth-grade intermediate warrior, which is really shabby.

    Lu Zhou retracted his thoughts, suppressed his turbulent thoughts, and looked at the 874,622 taels of silver. Without any hesitation, he devoted all his thoughts to improving his realm.

    Right now, your own strength is king!

    Only those who are strong enough can survive!

    boom!

    A roar suddenly sounded.

    System prompts appeared one after another...

    [Consumption of 20,000 taels of silver, the realm is upgraded to the ninth level! 】

    [Consumption of 50,000 taels of silver, the realm is upgraded to the top level of the ninth level! 】

    [Consumption of 100,000 taels of silver, the realm is upgraded to the eighth level elementary level! 】

    …

    The amount of silver was being consumed rapidly, and Lu Zhou's level was also soaring.

    He only felt that the energy and blood in his body were constantly rushing, like a torrent that burst a dam, constantly washing away the main meridians in his body.

    Every flush brings an indescribable sense of comfort, as if the two meridians of Ren and Du were instantly opened, without any stagnation.

    The strong power grows within the body...

    Cool!

    Lu Zhou saw that he had entered the eighth-level warrior category, and his joy was beyond words.

    You know, the predecessor worked hard for more than twenty years, but he was only at the beginning of the ninth grade.

    Countless martial arts talents train hard day and night, and it takes several years of hard work to reach the eighth level.

    And with just a single amount of silver, he has reached a height that many people only dream of!

    This feeling is simply too good!

    And...

    This is far from over.

    To become an eighth-level warrior, less than half of the silver was consumed.

    The remaining silver is still being consumed, and his realm continues to improve...

    [Consumption of 360,000 taels of silver, the realm is upgraded to the top level of the eighth level! 】
title_en: Chapter 2 Krypton gold makes you stronger
